title: From Intent to Improvement: Agentic Dataset Search for Better Model Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.39608v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Finding training data in million-scale machine learning repositories is a Web search problem where text relevance is not enough. A query couples a semantic training goal with constraints such as task, license, and training stage, and the metadata that would verify them are often missing. Text retrieval ranks dataset cards by similarity but cannot enforce hard constraints or follow the relations that reach a sparsely described dataset. Free-form tool-calling agents are more flexible, but the same model that picks a dataset also declares it a match, and nothing checks that the query's constraints are actually met. Neither approach establishes that the data it returns will improve model training. To address it, we propose AgenticDS, a contract-governed agentic framework in which every language model decision instantiates a typed object before deterministic code consumes it. translated_title: 从意图到改进：面向更优模型训练的智能体式数据集搜索
translated_abstract: 在百万级规模的机器学习仓库中寻找训练数据本质上是一个网页搜索问题，但仅靠文本相关性是不够的。一个查询将语义化的训练目标与诸如任务、许可证和训练阶段等约束条件结合在一起，而用于验证这些约束的元数据往往缺失。文本检索通过相似度对数据集卡片进行排序，但无法强制执行硬性约束，也无法追踪那些能够关联到描述稀疏的数据集的关系。自由形式的工具调用智能体虽然更加灵活，但选择数据集的同一个模型也会宣布它是匹配项，没有任何机制检查查询的约束是否真正得到满足。这两种方法都无法保证其返回的数据能够改进模型训练。为解决这一问题，我们提出了AgenticDS，一个由契约治理的智能体框架，其中每个语言模型决策在确定性代码消费它之前都会实例化为一个类型化对象。该框架将查询编译为类型化的搜索计划并执行……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了契约治理的智能体式数据集搜索框架AgenticDS，通过将语言模型的每个决策实例化为类型化对象并由确定性代码校验，确保检索到的训练数据满足查询的硬性约束并真正提升模型训练效果。
en_tdlr: AgenticDS is a contract-governed agentic framework that compiles queries into typed search plans and instantiates every LLM decision as a typed object validated by deterministic code, ensuring retrieved training datasets satisfy hard constraints and genuinely improve model training.
